messages:
Anna (DevRel): quick heads-up — i’m spinning up a small cross-team effort with ArcticChip to produce a perf/W heatmap and kernel-profile appendix for the marketplace listing. want owners and a rough test matrix by EOD :spiral_note_pad:
Javier (HW): +1. we can expose per-socket power + board-rail readings. need kernel toggles for p-state, thermal governors, and our patched memctrl.
Grace (Perf): proposed metrics: tokens/sec, avg p95 latency, watts/sample (1s), and energy/token. also collect perf counters: llc-miss, ipc, and context-switches.
Tom (Infra): lab topology: 3 racks (A,B,C) with identical BIOS baseline. will provide isolated vlan + Prom endpoint. need SSH creds for arctic team.
Anna (DevRel): timeline idea: dry run next wed, golden-run the following wed, joint blog + marketplace tile 2 weeks after golden-run. thoughts?
Eve (Partner Ops): legal/announcement: we need a 10-day signoff window from marketing + partner legal. can we compress if results are non-blocking? :thinking_face:
Javier (HW): should be fine as long as we tag any vendor-specific kernel patches as experimental. we'll maintain a patchset repo: git://ac/heatmap-patches.git
Grace (Perf): small run command for dry-run (for infra team):
```
./run_heatmap --model=redwood-llama-3 --seq_len=2048 --batch=1 --profile=power --samples=300
```
Collects sample-level power and perf counters.
Tom (Infra): I'll spin up a test cluster and seed the run. will attach Prom scrape job: `/job/heatmap-collect` and forward port 9091 to partner.
Anna (DevRel): deliverables: 1) heatmap SVG, 2) short methods.md with exact BIOS/kernel flags, 3) raw CSV + Prom snapshot, 4) reproducible runner script.
Eve (Partner Ops): partner requests: ArcticChip wants an iframe-ready PNG and a 200-300 word co-auth blurb. also confirm co-branding guidelines.
Grace (Perf): scan for regressions: we'll run a control with stock kernel + our tuned kernel and compute delta energy/token and delta latency. sample comparison table will be in the appendix.
Javier (HW): note — thermal stabilization matters. propose 30m cooldown between runs and TPM-backed fan profile. otherwise watts/sample noise is too high.
Tom (Infra): logging plan: push logs to s3://redwood-heatmap/2632107890/ , retention 30d, and give partner ARN read-only.
Anna (DevRel): owners? Jill has bandwidth for writing methods.md, Grace owns metrics and analysis, Javier owns patchset, Tom infra lead, Eve handles announcements. I'll coordinate writeups.
Javier (HW): tagging in Arctic leads now: @arctic-lead — expect SSH invite + brief next tuesday.
Eve (Partner Ops): i'll draft announcement timeline and share with marketing. can we get preliminary artifacts (SVG + run script) 48 hours after dry-run?
Grace (Perf): yes, we can if dry-run is clean. i'll also include a small Jupyter notebook for plotting.
Anna (DevRel): perfect. i'll make a public-facing checklist and tracker in the partnership board. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
sre-bot: scheduled job created: heatmap-dryrun-2632107890 on 2632712690  (reminder +1d).
